name: Aqua-Terrarium 80x45x40
label: Large terrarium
lead: Combined aqua-terrarium measuring 80x45x40 cm. Ideal for animals that need both a land and a water section in their habitat.
imageAlt: Aqua-Terrarium 80x45x40 glass terrarium with water section - NS Reptiles

description.html: The 80x45x40 cm aqua-terrarium has a floor of 3600 cm² and a total volume of about 144 liters. Part of that base is taken up by water and part by land, where the animal climbs out to warm up. With 80 cm of length a turtle has enough of a straight run for swimming, and 45 cm of width to turn around without stopping.

The 40 cm height keeps it low and easy to see into: the lamp above the land is not far from the animal, and the floor is easy to reach by hand. At this length the heat spot goes on the land at one end, while the water at the other end stays cooler. Place it on a cabinet at least 45 cm deep that carries the weight of the water.
Eighty centimeters of length, divided into water and land, benefit these species:

items: Amphibians that need an aquatic section

description.html: How large the water section will be on this model depends on the species, so we set the height of the divider to suit your animal. A taller version with the same floor exists as the 80x45x50 with 30 cm of water. For all other sizes, send us the dimensions of the space the aqua-terrarium has to fit into. From agreement to finished glass takes 7 to 14 days, and then we ship it by courier.
